description: Consolidate dashboard factory GET/PUT behind one session-scoped client with save modes (REPLACE_CURRENT and UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE), migrate editor save and import confirm flows off POST /factories, and centralize error mapping—after backend session-factory-save-modes (S1) ships.

context.customerAsk: One GET/PUT session factory client with mode + factory; import dialog; remove POST /factories. Program dependency: complete backend session-factory-save-modes (S1) before implementation.
context.problem: Factory definition I/O is split across current-factory-definition, named-factory (POST /factories), and factory-definition normalization. Import cannot offer create-new-named without the legacy POST path, save modes are not represented in the UI, and overlapping modules make session-scoped behavior hard to verify.
context.solution: Add a session-factory API client aligned with S1 OpenAPI, delegate current-factory get/save through it, restrict editor saves to REPLACE_CURRENT, add import confirm UX for replace vs create-new-named with correct mode/name/version rules, remove createFactory, and unify API error mapping for save and import.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard factory definition writes use only GET/PUT on /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory with { mode?, factory } bodies after S1.
Editor Save uses REPLACE_CURRENT (or omitted default mode) only; no editor path calls UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE.
Import confirm offers Replace current factory (default) and Create new named factory, driving the correct PUT mode, name, and version rules per choice.
No dashboard save or import flow calls POST /factories; createFactory is removed from the UI API surface.
selectedSessionID from the dashboard session store threads to session factory GET/PUT for the active tab.
Canonical factory normalization remains in factory-definition; session transport does not reshape topology.
Quality gate: UI typecheck, lint, and affected unit and integration tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: Session factory transport client
userStories.description: As a frontend maintainer, I want one module that performs session factory GET/PUT against the regenerated OpenAPI contract so all features share one HTTP shape.
acceptanceCriteria: After S1 lands, regenerate ui/src/api/generated/openapi.ts so PUT accepts mode and factory per backend contract.
ui/src/api/session-factory/ exports getSessionFactory(sessionID) and saveSessionFactory({ sessionID, mode?, factory }).
PUT body is { mode?: REPLACE_CURRENT | UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE, factory: Factory } with version inside factory when supplied.
GET and PUT use currentFactorySessionPath(sessionID) and shared transport.ts helpers.
Unit tests assert HTTP method, path, and JSON body for default and non-default session IDs for GET and PUT with each save mode.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Current factory document delegates to session client
userStories.description: As a feature developer, I want existing getCurrentFactoryDocument and saveCurrentFactoryDocument to call the session factory client so hooks do not duplicate fetch logic.
acceptanceCriteria: getCurrentFactoryDocument and saveCurrentFactoryDocument delegate to getSessionFactory and saveSessionFactory with unchanged observable behavior.
SaveCurrentFactoryInput.baseVersion maps to factory.version on the PUT body only.
React Query keys and useSaveCurrentFactory / useCurrentFactoryDefinition hook signatures are unchanged unless documented as breaking.
Existing current-factory-definition unit tests pass or are updated to mock the session client.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Editor save always replaces current factory
userStories.description: As a factory editor, I want Save to update the factory I am editing in the active session without switching named factories or save modes.
acceptanceCriteria: useSaveCurrentFactory sends mode REPLACE_CURRENT or omits mode on every editor save path.
No graph editor, activity card, worker, or workstation save path sends UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE.
STALE_FACTORY_VERSION and FACTORY_NOT_IDLE errors surface in the same UI states as before migration.
Save on a non-default session tab PUTs to that session factory endpoint when selectedSessionID is set.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Import confirm dialog with replace vs create choice
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want to choose on import confirm whether to replace the current factory or create a new named factory, with accessible defaults and loading/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Import preview confirm dialog appears on all session tabs and defaults to Replace current factory.
Operator can select Create new named factory before confirming via keyboard-accessible controls.
Dialog shows the resolved factory name for the create path once derived, including numeric suffix when applicable.
Confirm shows submitting state during activation; errors use the existing import error panel pattern.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Import activation uses session PUT save modes
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want import confirm to persist via the correct save mode so replace keeps my current name and create adds or upserts a new named factory in this session.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace path: GET current factory, set factory.name to session current name ignoring PNG name, PUT REPLACE_CURRENT with factory.version from GET.
Create path: derive factory.name from PNG metadata, allocate suffixed name on conflict, PUT UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE with version omitted for new names and included when upserting an existing name.
useFactoryImportActivation uses session factory client only; no POST /factories.
App.import.test.tsx and factory-import-second-session.integration.test.mjs assert PUT mode and body per dialog choice and session.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Remove legacy named-factory create path
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dead POST /factories client surface removed so the dashboard cannot regress to global create.
acceptanceCriteria: createFactory is removed from ui/src/api/named-factory/api.ts after call-site migration.
No dashboard import or save code references POST /factories.
Contract tests for named-factory flows expect session PUT only.
Storybook fetchMocks for current-factory and import stories use session factory paths and modes.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Unified session factory error mapping
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want consistent, actionable error messages in save and import dialogs when the session factory API rejects a request.
acceptanceCriteria: Session factory client maps STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, INVALID_FACTORY, INVALID_FACTORY_NAME, and related codes to one error surface for save and import without duplicate switch logic in hooks.
Import preview shows stale-version guidance when the API returns STALE_FACTORY_VERSION.
Network and 5xx failures use the same recoverable copy patterns as before migration.
Unit tests cover stale, not-idle, and invalid-factory mappings from mocked HTTP responses.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
